ruleDefinitions.name: Chmod Suspicious Directory
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects chmod targeting files in abnormal directory paths.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/chmod$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/tmp\\/.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/\\\.Library\\/.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/etc\\/.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/opt\\/.*")))
